# AI Readiness Audit Intake Template

This template is for a local operator workflow. It is not legal advice, not
compliance certification, not security certification, not public SaaS, not a
guaranteed AI transformation plan, not a new reasoning mode, and not a
first-class backend runtime template.

Human review is required before any output is shared or acted on. Readiness
findings are directional, not guarantees.

## Project Name

`[Short name for the AI readiness decision]`

## Readiness Question

`[Which AI use case, workflow, team, or business unit needs a readiness review? Use one sentence if possible.]`

- Business goal: `[Revenue, cost, quality, cycle-time, risk, customer, or operational objective]`
- Candidate use case: `[Workflow or decision where AI is being considered]`

## Recommended Upload Files

- `[Business goals, use-case shortlist, initiative charter, or prioritization notes]`
- `[Process map, SOP, workflow note, queue description, or exception-handling notes]`
- `[Data inventory, data dictionary, quality report, dashboard summary, or sample-safe extract]`
- `[Tool-stack inventory, architecture notes, integration constraints, or vendor documentation]`
- `[Team capability, training, adoption, support, or change-readiness notes]`
- `[Governance, privacy, security, legal, compliance, HR, IT, or risk review notes]`
- `[Current KPI baseline, monitoring plan, or success metric definition]`

Do not upload secrets, credentials, API keys, unrelated personal data,
regulated data, sensitive employee records, customer data that is not approved
for local processing, or files that should not be processed in the local
runtime.

## Expected Output Types

- Client-safe after review: `report`, `client_dossier`,
  `client_monitoring_template`.
- Operator-only: `operator_dossier`, `operator_monitoring_template`.
- Internal archive: `machine_archive`.

## Human Review Notes

`[What must the operator verify before delivery? Include evidence maturity, readiness caveats, risk classification, human oversight, unresolved questions, reviewer needs, first 30/60/90-day actions, success metrics, monitoring, and any content that must stay internal.]`
